# Ambrose Kerr

## Overview

- **Age:** Roughly fifty years old  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032)</sub>

## Appearance

Ambrose has extremely long, uncut hair and an unshaven face that gives him the appearance of a cheap side-show oddity, a contemporary Nazarite, or an ancient Hebrew prophet. He is in his middle age and has been described by Captain Saul as an exceptionally grand person despite his unusual look.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P33](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0033), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021)_

## Personality

Ambrose is exceedingly resolute and possesses an obstinate determination that exceeds what is natural. He has a quick temper, but he is also capable of remorse. Politically, he is an unyielding Grit who holds fierce political convictions.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017), [v4 c37 P18](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0018)_

## Traits

- Resolute and obstinate  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- Quick-tempered  <sub>[v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017), [v4 c37 P18](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0018)</sub>
- Fiercely devoted to political causes  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)</sub>

## Abilities

- Cod-fishing  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>

## Goals

- Fulfill his political oath by refraining from shaving or cutting his hair until the Grits achieve political power  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)</sub>

## History

Ambrose Kerr grew up as a passionate Liberal political supporter. During a particularly fierce general election campaign fifteen years earlier, he publicly swore that he would not trim his hair or shave his face until power belonged to the Grits. When his party failed to win, he steadfastly kept his promise, allowing his hair and beard to grow wild for fifteen years and causing local residents and visitors to view him as a eccentric sight. As he reached middle age, he continued cod-fishing and maintained a long-standing acquaintance with Captain Saul Garrick. On the final hour of the old year, Ambrose joined Captain Saul, Dr. Hugh Carrow, Nell Carrow, and Lorna Ainslie to welcome the New Year at the lighthouse. Eventually, he became engaged to Miss Winifred Bryant and agreed to marry her in roughly four weeks, telling her she could wear a wedding veil alongside a navy blue silk gown if she wished.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021), [v4 c37 P25](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0025), [v4 c37 P26](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0026)_
